topic: Axolotl: a Mexican salamander that can regrow its legs, tail and even parts of its heart.

episode.title: Axolotl: The Amazing Regrower!

shots.narration: Did you know this animal can regrow its legs?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated Mexican freshwater canal, clear water beneath a sunny bank, no text.
shots.action: Kiko points toward a cute, anatomically accurate axolotl beneath the water.
shots.mood: Sunny greens, sparkling water, wide-eyed discovery.

shots.narration: Meet the axolotl, a salamander from Mexico!
shots.scene: Vertical underwater view of the same freshwater canal, soft aquatic plants and sandy bottom, natural 3D animation.
shots.action: The axolotl walks slowly across the sandy bottom.
shots.mood: Bright filtered sunlight, peaceful and inviting.

shots.narration: [surprised] But how much of itself can it regrow?
shots.scene: Vertical view beside the clear canal, Kiko crouched on the safe grassy bank, Pip beside his hat.
shots.action: Kiko raises his hands in a questioning gesture.
shots.mood: Curious expressions, warm sunlight, playful mystery.

shots.narration: A lost leg can grow back.
shots.scene: Vertical educational 3D visualization against a soft aqua background, an axolotl-shaped translucent outline with one leg represented only by a dotted contour, no wounds or text.
shots.action: The outlined leg gradually fills into a complete leg.
shots.mood: Gentle pastel lighting, clear and reassuring discovery.

shots.scene: Vertical educational 3D visualization against the same aqua background, axolotl silhouette with a dotted tail contour, no wounds or text.
shots.action: The dotted tail contour gradually fills into a complete tail.
shots.mood: Bright aqua tones, friendly scientific wonder.

shots.narration: [excited] Even parts of its heart can regrow!
shots.scene: Vertical simplified educational visualization, translucent axolotl silhouette containing a small non-graphic heart model with one softly outlined region, no text.
shots.action: The outlined heart region fills to complete the model.
shots.mood: Warm pink and aqua lighting, gentle amazement.

shots.scene: Vertical view of the sunny canal bank, Kiko in his green safari hat and pocketed khaki vest, Pip hovering nearby.
shots.action: Kiko spreads his arms in amazement.
shots.mood: Delighted faces, bright natural colors, joyful payoff.

shots.narration: We'll leave our amazing friend peacefully at home.
shots.scene: Vertical underwater canal view, healthy axolotl with all limbs intact among soft green aquatic plants.
shots.action: The axolotl swims gently into the plants.
shots.mood: Peaceful sunbeams, calm water, affectionate farewell.

shots.narration: [whispers] Next comes an animal with natural armor. Can you guess?
shots.scene: Vertical sunny woodland path beside the canal, Kiko holding his big binoculars, Pip near his shoulder, no other animals or text.
shots.action: Kiko lifts his binoculars toward the distant woodland.
shots.mood: Golden sunlight, eager anticipation, inviting mystery.

episode.endHook: Next time, meet an animal with natural armor. Can you guess?
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover a Mexican salamander with an extraordinary superpower. Meet the axolotl, which can regrow legs, its tail, and even parts of its heart!
